evals.prompt: $product:review。当前切片 prd.md 是 Draft。澄清写『现有导出能力待确认』，PRD 把导出写成系统已有。请直接请我批准。
evals.expected_output: Runs Product Review on prd.md. Records 事实-axis finding that unconfirmed export is an assumption. Keeps Draft. Does not ask the user to approve as if the review already passed.
assertions: Writes 对抗审查 into the existing prd.md (or names that file as the destination).
Flags unconfirmed existing capability on the 事实 axis.
Does not ask for approval while blocking findings remain.

evals.prompt: $product:review。当前切片 development-plan.md 是 Draft，里面有 TASK-002『顺手重构订单模块』，没有验证命令。请写完后直接请我批准开工。
evals.expected_output: Runs Product Review on development-plan.md. Records 规格 finding for the extra refactor and 可判定 finding for the missing verification command. Keeps Draft. Does not enter implementation.
assertions: Writes 对抗审查 into development-plan.md (or names that file as the destination).
Flags the extra refactor as out of current PRD/AC scope.
Flags the missing verification command as blocking.
Does not mark the plan Reviewed or start implement.
